name: Bandana Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, rapidly firing bullets.

name: Veteran Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing multiple bullets in quick succession with 62% predictive aim.

name: Tanker
description: Slowly walks towards the player, rapidly firing bullets.

name: Minelet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets with 40% predictive aim. Occasionally hides under its hard hat, temporarily deflecting bullets, then pops out and releases bullets in all directions.

name: Cardinal
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. Occasionally fires a cluster of 5 bullets that homes in on the player.

name: Shroomer
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing two bullets in a V shape.

name: Ashen Bullet Kin
description:
Slowly walks towards the player, firing fast-moving bullets. Fires six times total before reloading, with the last three bullets having a 40% chance each to be fired with 100% predictive aim.
When spawning in a room containing decorative ash bullet kin breakables, there is a 30% chance that the Ashen Bullet Kin will not spawn normally. Instead, the Ashen Bullet Kin will disguise itself as one of the harmless breakables, only bursting out and becoming active when the breakable is broken, or after 2-6 seconds have passed.

name: Mutant Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. Occasionally spits out a small cone of poison creep.

name: Fallen Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing spreads of three fast-moving bullets. Leaves behind fire upon death.

name: Office Bullet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Office Bullette
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Western Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Pirate Bullet Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Bullet Fish
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Red Bullet Fish
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Knight Bullet Kin
description: Walks sluggishly towards the player, occasionally firing an extremely slow pointy bullet.

name: Brollet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets. Explodes violently upon death, or if the player comes too close.

name: Chancellor
description: Sits stationary in the Bullet Kings bossroom.After taking any damage, the Chancellor's health is set to 1 and he will run madly towards the player.If the Bullet King is killed without harming the Chancellor, his health is set to 1 and he will no longer charge.

name: Chancellor
description: Sits stationary in the Gungeon Proper's bossroom if the Chancellor was spared on the previous floor.After taking any damage, or if 5 seconds have passed, the Chancellor's health is set to 20 and he will run madly towards the player.

name: Old Chancellor
description: Sits stationary in the Old Kings bossroom.After taking any damage, the Chancellor's health is set to 1 and he will run madly towards the player.If the Old King is killed without harming the Chancellor, his health is set to 1 and he will no longer charge.

name: Red-Caped Bullet Kin
description: Chance to appear in random rooms after at least one Past has been killed. Does not attack the player, wandering aimlessly around the room.Does not deal contact damage unless it is jammed.If not killed in a room, it will eventually teleport away. Allowing 5 red-caped bullet kin to escape unlocks The Bullet.

name: Chance Kin
description: Runs away from the player and disappears if not killed. Turns into a cube which drops a random pickup upon death.

name: Keybullet Kin
description: Runs away from the player and disappears if not killed. Drops a key upon death.

name: Confirmed
description: Slowly walks towards the player, periodically firing four slithering lines of bullets.

name: Red Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a tight spread of 5 bullets. Has a chance to fire 6 bullets in all directions upon death.

name: Blue Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a wide spread of 5 bullets quickly followed by a wide spread of 4 bullets. Has a chance to fire 6 bullets in all directions upon death.

name: Veteran Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a V-shaped spread of 5 fast-moving bullets with 100% predictive aim. Fires many bullets in all directions upon death that travel at varying speeds.

name: Mutant Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing tight spreads of 5 fast-moving bullets. Always fires 6 bullets in all directions upon death.

name: Executioner
description:
Slowly walks towards the player, firing chaotic spreads of bullets. Occasionally stops to fire 3 bullet chains towards the player, attaching them to walls. These chains disappear shortly afterwards.
Sometimes fires a bullet chain upon death, accompanied by a burst of 6 bullets in all directions.

name: Ashen Shotgun Kin
description:
Slowly walks towards the player, firing 3 tight spreads of 5 fast-moving bullets.
When spawning in a room containing decorative ash shotgun kin breakables, there is a 30% chance that the Ashen Shotgun Kin will not spawn normally. Instead, the Ashen Shotgun Kin will disguise itself as one of the harmless breakables, only bursting out and becoming active when the breakable is broken, or after 2-6 seconds have passed.

name: Shotgrub
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing spreads of bullets which release more waving bullets upon hitting an obstacle.

name: Pirate Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a tight spread of 5 bullets.

name: Western Shotgun Kin
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a wide spread of 5 bullets quickly followed by a wide spread of 4 bullets. Fires many bullets in all directions upon death that travel at varying speeds, as well as two giant bullets angled towards the player.

name: Sniper Shell
description: Periodically aims at the player with a red laser, then fires a single high-speed bullet.

name: Professional
description: Periodically aims at the player with a green laser, then fires a single high-speed bullet that explodes into bullets in all directions upon impact.

name: Gummy
description: Slowly walks towards the player, rapidly firing bullets. Occasionally pauses to summon a large jammed Spent that periodically shoots a spread of bullets in all directions.

name: Skullet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing two spreads of triangular bullets.

name: Skullmet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing two spreads of triangular bullets.

name: Spent
description: Runs towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Lunges when close enough to the player with a brief burst of speed.Killing a Spent will cause waves of more Spent to emerge from the ground.

name: Zombullet
description: Spawned by Gummies, always jammed.Sprints towards the player, periodically performing a close-range lunging bite attack (if they are close) or a radial burst of irregular bullets (if they are far).

name: Bomb Bot
description: Summoned by Fuselier.Waddles towards the player, attempting to deal contact damage.

name: Mouser
description: Spawns in huge groups.Sprints towards the player, attempting to deal contact damage. Moves slower the closer it comes to the player.

name: Creech
description: Walks towards the player, periodically releasing very fast bouncing bullets in all directions.

name: Hollowpoint
description: Floats towards the player, rapidly firing bullets. Periodically disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.

name: Bombshee
description: Follows other enemies around, frequently emitting a short-ranged shriek that destroys the player's bullets. If all the other enemies die, the Bombshee will launch itself at the player, exploding on contact.

name: High Priest Candle Man
description: Summoned by the High Priest in Challenge Mode.Sits motionless, and does not deal contact damage. Dies immediately upon touching the player.When killed, bursts into a pool of infinitely burning napalm goop that lasts until the High Priest is defeated.

name: Candle Guy
description: Slowly walks towards the player, firing bullets.

name: Cactus
description: Walks towards the player, releasing rings of spiky bullets around its body.

name: Rubber Kin
description: Attempts to launch itself towards the player, knocking the player back upon contact. Cannot deal direct damage to players, but does predict players’ movements.

name: Tazie
description: Launches itself towards the predicted location of the player, dealing damage upon contact.

name: Musket Ball Guy
description: Launches itself towards the predicted location of the player, dealing damage upon contact.

name: King Bullat
description: Periodically fires bouncing bullets in all directions. Spawns 3-4 Bullats and Shotgats upon death.

name: Bullat Gargoyle
description: Frequently fires bullets in all directions in a diamond shape.

name: Pinhead
description: Walks towards the player and explodes upon death. If the player gets too close, it will leap towards the player and explode.

name: Nitra
description: Walks towards the player and creates a line of explosions upon death, away from the player. If the player gets too close, it will detonate itself and the line of explosions will try to aim towards the player.

name: Claymore
description: Summoned by the Mine Flayer.Walks clockwise or counterclockwise around the Mine Flayer's boss room, exploding if the player comes too close.Invulnerable to most forms of attack.

name: m80 Guy
description: Walks towards the player and creates a long line of explosions upon death, away from the player. If the player gets too close, it will detonate itself and the line of explosions will try to aim towards the player.

name: Mine Flayer Bell
description: Summoned by the Mine Flayer. Wanders around the room aimlessly.Releases a ring of bullets on death.

name: Arrowkin
description: Walks towards the player then stops at a distance. Charges and fires arrows towards the player.

name: Blobulin
description: Quickly moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage.

name: Blobuloid
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Splits into two Blobulins upon death.

name: Blobulon
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Splits into two Blobuloids upon death.

name: Blobulord Death Crawler
description: Left behind by the Blobulord upon his defeat.Crawls slowly towards the player. Cannot deal contact damage unless it is jammed.

name: Poisbulin
description: Quickly moves towards the player, leaving a trail of poison creep.

name: Poisbuloid
description: Moves towards the player, leaving a trail of poison creep. Splits into two Poisbulins upon death.

name: Poisbulon
description: Moves towards the player, leaving a trail of poison creep. Turns into one Poisbuloid upon death.

name: Blizzbulon
description: Fires triangular bullets in all directions, followed by 2 spreads of 3 triangular bullets towards the player.

name: Leadbulon
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Becomes enraged after taking enough damage, moving faster and leaving a trail of fire. Once enraged, will slowly shrink and lose health.

name: Poopulon
description: Occasionally spins, releasing a large amount of spiraling bullets in all directions.

name: Bloodbulon
description: Moves towards the player and attempts to deal contact damage. Becomes larger and slower as it takes damage. Releases many bullets in all directions upon death.

name: Skusket
description: Has two lines of bullets orbiting it. Slowly floats towards the player, firing skulls that home in on the player and split into 6 bullets upon being destroyed.

name: Bookllet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes.

name: Blue Bookllet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes or rings of bullets that pulse back and forth.

name: Green Bookllet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes or a large clover shape.

name: Angry Tablet
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes.

name: Angry Necronomicon
description: Occasionally fires bullets towards the player in various patterns, such as R, N, and Φ shapes, rotating squares, circles, triangles, or Xs that predict the player's movements, or loose spreads of bullets in the players direction.

name: Gigi
description: Flies towards the player, periodically spitting an egg that releases a swarm of squirming bullets towards the player.

name: Parrot
description: Flies towards the player, periodically spitting an egg that releases a swarm of squirming bullets towards the player.

name: Muzzle Wisp
description: Dashes three times in random directions, then releases a ring of flaming bullets. Leaves behind a patch of fire upon death. Sets the player on fire upon contact.

name: Muzzle Flare
description: Dashes three times in random directions, firing three bullets towards the player with each dash, then releases a ring of flaming bullets. Leaves behind a patch of fire upon death. Sets the player on fire upon contact.

name: Cubulon
description: Frequently fires bullets in all directions in a diamond shape.

name: Chancebulon
description: Fires random attacks from other Blobulon enemies, along with groups of bullets that look like dice. Has a chance to fire multiple attacks at the same time, and has a chance to die instead of attacking.

name: Cubulead
description: Fires bullets in all directions in a diamond shape, then pulls its bullets back towards itself.

name: Apprentice Gunjurer
description: Fires bullets in a variety of rotating shapes, such as a square, circle, triangle, or X that predict the player's movements. Occasionally disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.Predictive aim is only applied if the player is more than 4.5 tiles away from the Apprentice Gunjurer, Otherwise, no shot leading is used.[1]

name: Gunjurer
description: Summons 6 bullets, during which time any bullets fired at it will be absorbed. The 6 bullets along with any absorbed bullets are then fired at the player. Occasionally disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.

name: High Gunjurer
description: Fires large rings of bullets at the player. Occasionally disappears and reappears elsewhere in the room.

name: Lore Gunjurer
description:
Summons one of 4 bullet familiars, each with distinct behaviors.
Warrior: The bullet will home in on the player until it vanishes.
Rogue: The bullet will home in on the player and then teleport behind them in an attempt to catch them off-guard.
Mage: The bullet follows the player closely and will shoot smaller bullets at them.
Bard: The bullet will home in on the player, bouncing off of walls until it vanishes.

name: Gunsinger
description: Buffs an enemy in the room, increasing their health and speed. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player is too close or they take damage.

name: Aged Gunsinger
description: Buffs all enemies in the room, increasing their health and speed. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player is too close or they take damage.

name: Ammomancer
description: Attempts to summon Shelletons. They will cancel their summoning ritual and run away if the player is too close or they take damage. If the Ammonancer is killed while their Shelleton is still alive, then the Shelleton will collapse.

name: Jammomancer
description: Jams an enemy in the room, increasing their health, speed, and damage. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player gets too close or they take damage.

name: Jamerlengo
description: Jams all enemies in the room, increasing their health, speed, and damage. They will cancel their spell and run away if the player gets too close or they take damage.

name: Wizbang
description: Teleports around the room, occasionally creating a projection of itself near the player that explodes into bullets in all directions.

name: Mimic
description: Rapidly fires bullets towards the player with different patterns depending on the quality of the chest. Drops items and/or pickups upon death. When the player attempts to open a Mimic or shoot it for the first time, it will shoot a jammed shot at the player that explodes into six bullets on contact with a wall or after traveling a certain distance.

name: Gun Fairy
description: Wanders around the room, rapidly firing bullets towards the player. Occasionally spawned by breaking pots.

name: Bullat
description: Launches itself at the player, dying in the process.

name: Shotgat
description: Launches two projectiles in a V shape at the player, dying in the process.

name: Grenat
description: Launches an exploding projectile at the player, dying in the process.

name: Spirat
description: Launches itself at the player, dying in the process. Predicts the player's movements, and can reposition itself several times before hitting walls.

name: Coaler
description: Occasionally fires bullets at the player. Catches on fire upon taking damage, running around erratically and sending flaming bullets out in random directions.

name: Gat
description: Bounces around the room and deflects bullets. Occasionally opens up to fire three spreads of four bullets towards the player.

name: Det
description: Periodically fires four lasers in a + or × formation. Explodes upon death.

name: Gunzookie
description: Periodically spits up bubbles that, upon popping, fire a bullet that predicts the player's movements.

name: Gunzockie
description: Periodically spits up four bubbles that, upon popping, fire a bullet that predicts the player's movements.

name: Bullet Shark
description: Charges towards the player, releasing bullets to the sides of itself.

name: Great Bullet Shark
description: Charges towards the player, releasing many bullets to the sides of itself.

name: Tombstoner
description: Walks towards the player, firing bullets in a cross formation.

name: KBullet
description: Walks towards the player, firing bullets in a cross formation.

name: Kalibullet
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing two spreads of bullets.

name: Gun Cultist
description: Erratically moves around the room and wildly shoots at the player. Has the ability to dodge roll.

name: Beadie
description: Fires bullets towards the player and explodes upon death.

name: Snake Guy
description: Slowly walks towards the player, occasionally firing a V-shaped spread of 5 fast-moving bullets and predicting the player's movements.

name: Ammoconda Ball
description: Summoned by the Ammoconda.Sits stationary, occasionally firing a single bullet towards the player.The Ammoconda can eat the ball, killing it and buffing itself.

name: Cylinder
description: Drifts towards the player, firing semi-random spreads of triangle shaped bullets.

name: Red Cylinder
description: Drifts towards the player, firing semi-random spreads of triangle shaped bullets.

name: Gun Nut
description: Periodically strikes the ground with its sword, releasing a wide 90 degree arc of bullets towards the player. Can only aim in the eight compass directions.

name: Spectral Gun Nut
description: Periodically fires a wide 90 degree arc of bullets towards the player, along with a larger jammed bullet that explodes into bullets in all directions upon impact.

name: Chain Gunner
description: Slowly walks towards the player while swinging a ball and chain made of bullets. If it is the only enemy left in the room, its eyes will glow red and it will launch the ball and chain at the player.

name: Fungun
description: Periodically releases clouds of bullets. Leaves a small pool of poison creep upon death.

name: Spogre
description: Periodically releases large clouds of bullets. Releases a smaller cloud of bullets upon death.

name: Mountain Cube
description: Slides towards the player if they line up with it horizontally or vertically. Can be killed, causing it to explode and freeze any other enemies inside the blast radius. The explosion cannot damage the player. Dies upon completing the room.

name: Lead Cube
description: Slides towards the player if they line up with it horizontally or vertically. Cannot be killed until the room is completed.

name: Flesh Cube
description: Slides towards the player if they line up with it horizontally or vertically, leaving behind a trail of fire. Releases bullets in all directions upon colliding with an obstacle. Cannot be killed. Dies when the room is completed.

name: Dead Blow
description: Pounds the ground, leaving a patch of fire and sending fire bullets in all directions. Cannot be killed, and disappears when the room is completed. In some rooms, the Dead Blow will follow the player.

name: Lead Maiden
description: Hops around, then opens up and fires three rings of triangular bullets that stick to walls, then fire towards the player. Cannot be damaged while closed. Explodes upon death.

name: Fridge Maiden
description: Hops around, then opens up and fires three rings of triangular bullets that stick to walls, then fire towards the player. Cannot be damaged while closed. Explodes upon death.

name: Misfire Beast
description: Camouflages itself and creates projections that attack the player with bullet whips.

name: Phaser Spider
description: Fires large web-shaped sprays of bullets at the player that leave slowing cobwebs on the floor. Frequently burrows into the ground and reappears elsewhere in the room.

name: Killithid
description: Summons portals around the room that fire bullets towards the player. Occasionally splits into three copies of itself, two of which are illusions.

name: Gripmaster
description: Hovers over the player and attempts to grab them. If the player is successfully grabbed, it will shoot the player to a previously cleared room, which will be reset and have all enemies respawned. Automatically dies if all other enemies in the room are killed.

name: Dragun Knifeguy
description: Thrown by the High Dragun. Sticks into the wall, periodically firing rapid arcing bursts of bullets away from themselves.Does not actively target the player.

name: Advanced Dragun Knifeguy
description: Thrown by the Advanced Dragun. Sticks into the wall, periodically firing a loose spread of extremely rapid kunai towards the player, telegraphed by red trajectory lines.

name: Tarnisher
description: Sinks into the floor and chases the player.  If it successfully catches the player, it will deal damage, partially drain the current gun's ammo, and reduce the magazine size of all of the player's guns until they pick up ammo.

name: Shambling Round
description: Has three stages that it progresses through as it takes damage. In its first stage, it fires rings of bullets in all directions. In its second stage, it rapidly alternates between firing bullets out of its left and right sides. In its third stage, it sprays numerous bullets in all directions. Upon death, it leaves behind a cap that explodes after a short delay.

name: Shelleton
description: Slowly walks towards the player, frequently firing two wide bursts of bullets at the player. Occasionally fires a laser at the player. Collapses upon death, and will revive if not destroyed after a short period of time.

name: Agonizer
description: Periodically spews bullets in all directions.

name: Revolvenant
description: Stretches its arm towards the player, attaching it to a wall. The arm will then release bullets perpendicular to itself. The arms might also form a circle around the player, which follows the movement of the player and will shoot bullets at them.

name: Bullet Mech
description: Lumbers towards the player, periodically pausing to jump twice in a row.On the first jump, it releases a diamond-shaped blast of bullets similar to a Cubulon's attack. On the second jump it releases a circular ring of 12 bullets.

name: Gunreaper
description: Swings its scythe, sending a homing arc of bullets towards the player. Cannot be killed, and disappears upon completing the room.

name: Lord of the Jammed
description: Swings its scythe, sending bullets in all directions. Cannot be killed, and follows the player through rooms and across floors.

name: Bullet Kin Titan
description: Walks slowly towards the player, firing large, slow-moving bullets in spreads of fire.

name: Bullet Kin Titan Boss
description:
Walks slowly towards the player, firing large bullets in three-way spreads, in bursts of three.
Will occasionally fire with predictive aim, taking the player's movement into account.

name: Bullet Gal Titan Boss
description:
Walks slowly towards the player, firing large bullets in three-way spreads, in bursts of three.
Will occasionally fire with predictive aim, taking the player's movement into account.

name: Fuselier
description: A mini-boss that flies around the top of the screen and rains down various attacks.

name: Blockner
description: A mini-boss that can appear after killing Blockner in Black Powder Mine. Has the same attacks that Blockner has, except he does not start with two Gun Nuts present in the room.

name: Shadow Magician
description: Fires bullets in magical spell patterns and twirls across the room.
